original_test_intent: Gracefully restart the intended running SUT through BMC Web UI, proving clean OS shutdown, chassis/boot transition, restored service readiness and no unexpected new errors.
original_method: Drain workloads/storage, preserve baseline, issue one approved graceful restart, trace shutdown and boot separately through console/BMC/OS signals, then compare inventory, storage, health and events.
manual_activity: The owner approves the outage and defines graceful semantics/readiness; an operator supervises both shutdown and boot and decides any recovery escalation.
required_inputs: Outage approval and intended final ready state
Supported graceful Web UI action or documented equivalent
Clean workload/storage and no active update
Separate shutdown and boot readiness signals, timeouts and health oracle
safety_requirements: Drain workloads and writes before request
Do not substitute immediate off, reset or AC cycle
Monitor shutdown and boot as distinct phases
Stop on partial shutdown, storage activity, timeout or boot anomaly
No blind retry or forced escalation
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, approval and drain gates
Observe OS shutdown, chassis, console, POST and OS readiness
Compare post-boot inventory, storage, health and events without recovery autonomy or verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Inapplicable: rear-fan sensor reads belong to the duplicate row and do not exercise a restart.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the documented graceful Web UI/API restart once and poll authoritative shutdown and boot readiness signals.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Orderly restart, no-error criteria, scripts and 1/15-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines graceful semantics, separate phase gates and complete post-boot health evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Fan-speed listing proves neither shutdown nor boot recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A stalled shutdown or failed boot can leave services unavailable and may require owner-led recovery.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish or OS equivalent is acceptable only with documented graceful semantics; immediate restart or AC/reset remains a different test.
expected_evidence: Approval, target/on state and drain/update assessment
OS shutdown, chassis and console timeline

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1511 consistently defines orderly restart. The same-code rear-fan sensor row is a separate Source Key and variant.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Control semantics, approval, readiness and recovery inputs are supplyable, permitting attended conditional execution.

review_improvement: Replaces unrelated fan telemetry with a one-request graceful restart whose shutdown, boot and recovered-health phases are individually evidenced.
independent_technical_reasoning: A graceful restart succeeds only if both shutdown and subsequent service readiness complete. The control may be automated, but outage approval and any stalled-state recovery remain human decisions, so FULLY AUTOMATABLE is unsafe.
